palette.jordan_40: the approved Jordan v2 palette (eyes, star, puffs, mouth, mark rim)

pivot_convention: texel coordinates from the frame's top-left. A Sprite2D with centered=true needs offset = frame_size / 2 - pivot (texels); its position is then the pivot's screen point. Anchors are given in the same frame texels; screen = position + 3 * (anchor - pivot).
black_target: 14.2% (the approved kaiju layer) +-1.5 at fight size; the grow / shrink / toy sizes carry more line by nature and are reported, not held to it

kaiju_charge.note: the breath stance with the head taken off: draw kaiju_head_aim / kaiju_head_fire over it with their NECK pivot on this sheet's NECK, then kaiju_spines over both (normal blend)

kaiju_head_aim.note: head layer: frame i aims [-60, -40, -20, 0, 20, 40, 65, 90] deg (0 = the approved head, + turns it down / clockwise); put its NECK pivot on kaiju_charge NECK. MOUTH = the beam origin.

kaiju_head_fire.note: head layer: frame i aims [-60, -40, -20, 0, 20, 40, 65, 90] deg (0 = the approved head, + turns it down / clockwise); put its NECK pivot on kaiju_charge NECK. MOUTH = the beam origin.

kaiju_spines.note: overlay for kaiju_charge (same frame and pivot). Draw with NORMAL blend: it replaces the plate pixels it covers (opaque), its halo and sparks sit outside the body.

kaiju_drop.note: f0 shows the stomping (far, screen-right) foot's sole with the gold star sticker

kaiju_stumble.note: Jordan leaves the seat on f1; f4 == kaiju_kneel f0

kaiju_grow.note: baked sizes [12, 18, 26, 36, 48, 60, 72, 84, 94, 100]%, anchored on FEET; pink-gold puffs and gold stars are effects (fx layer); f0 is the toy; f9 == kaiju_idle f0

kaiju_shrink.note: sizes [100, 84, 60, 40, 24, 15, 12, 12]% on FEET with the puff; f7 is the toy (== kaiju_toy f0 placed on FEET)

kaiju_toy.note: the vinyl toy (the kaiju at 12%%): sit, crouch, hop, land; pivot = its feet. f0 is the same drawing as kaiju_grow f0 / kaiju_shrink f7

kaiju_shadow.note: solid black; the game sets its alpha. Pivot sits on the kaiju's FEET

kaiju_stomp_mark.note: f0-1 tracking flicker (a toed foot shadow), f2 high, f3 mid, f4 low, f5 landed. Rim = the (50, 35)-texel ellipse round the pivot on every frame

kaiju_stomp_impact.note: pivot on FOOT_IMPACT; floor layer; f5 = the cracks (hold)

kaiju_beam_body.note: 32x32 horizontal tile: repeat it along the beam (x), rotate the strip by code. Hit band 90 px = 30 texels; the drawn beam is rows 2..29 (28 texels = 84 px) with its glow edge

kaiju_beam_mouth.note: centred on MOUTH, drawn above the body

kaiju_beam_end.note: the splash where the beam meets the rope; the beam arrives from the left (rotate with the beam)

kaiju_burn_flame.note: upright blue flame, pivot bottom-centre; place every 36 px along the burn line, never rotated, phase-offset

kaiju_burn_out.note: the dying ember, same pivot as the flame
